description: Find passports by property name: exact or prefix match, at least 3 characters, at most 10 results, exact match first, then alphabetical. Optionally limited to a municipality. Every result is a property with a proven listing (L2/L2c), a verified operator (L3), a right to manage verified by document review (LA) or, marked L0 and unclaimed, facts from the operator's official website with nothing proven; the result names the tier and the date it was reached, and whether the registration number (Italy: CIN) was checked against the public register. Contact is direct with the operator and commission-free, so the traveler pays no platform fee. No result means nothing proven matches; nothing is inferred, estimated or filled in.

lang.description: Language of labels in the result; defaults to en

name.description: Property name or its beginning, at least 3 characters

name: lookup_by_name

contactPageUrl.description: Page with the passport and the operator's direct contact; give this link to the traveler

type.description: Accommodation type as stated by the operator

date.description: Date the tier was reached, YYYY-MM-DD

tier.description: Verification tier (docs: ADR 0012, 0017, 0024, 0025). L0 unclaimed: facts read from the operator's official website, nothing proven, the operator has not claimed the page; contact only through send_inquiry. L2 listing verified: the operator proved control of the platform listing (calendar export link with the listing id, platform email with a valid DKIM signature, or channel manager); since 2026-11-07 also their right to manage the property (LA or L3), and earlier L2 stands as it was reached. L2c listing calendar proven (Booking, Vrbo): the operator blocked a random date Ospitario named in that platform's calendar export within 48 hours; no new L2c since 2026-11-07. LA right-to-manage documents reviewed: Ospitario's admin checked documents tying the operator to this property (registration record, deed, lease, mandate or company register); a person found them consistent, without eID, so it does not prove who holds the account and never proves a platform listing. L3 operator verified: the operator's eID identity (SPID/CIE) matches the CIN holder in the national register's PDF. L4 document verified (automated check): an ownership, lease or mandate document is consistent with that identity and the property; it states consistency, not authenticity. L5 manually verified: a reviewer checked the document (an optional upgrade; it does not affect search order).

title: Look up a property by name
